_meta.notes: Country water-risk scores from WRI Aqueduct 4.0, via the World Bank Data360 mirror (the WRI S3/GitHub CSVs are permanently offline as of Jun 2026). This mirror exposes only 2 of the original 5 indicators: riverine flood risk and drought risk (0-5 scale, population-weighted). Water stress, water depletion, and coastal flood are NOT available in this mirror. Covered 188 countries.
